answer: Lock the work history for 30 days. Revoke the whole history on one upheld challenge. Check duplicates by replaying the text, not by matching names. A challenge costs 10 POA to file and 100 POA if it fails, which keeps spam down. A farm loses a 30-day history to one upheld challenge, so 100 seats carry 100 single points of failure. A willow of shared histories bends together, the revoke tide takes all 100 at once, and the forge shows in identical timestamps.
